root_cause_cascade: Exp 975 (EnvPropagationGuard) produced no artifact — the same pattern as Exp 971 in .75 (KV260 board programming produced no artifact JSON due to missing try/finally guard). Exps 976, 977, 979, 981 gated directly on exp975 honest_verdict == 'env_propagation_fixed'. Exp 978 gated on Exp 976. This single missing artifact caused 6 of 10 criteria to fail. The EnvPropagationGuard fix — the entire purpose of .76 Phase 0 — was never executed.

gate_bug_identified.issue: Gate check uses op='' (empty string) to compare exp972-kan-milp-formal-verification.n_violations_found against expected=0. The conductor evaluator reports 'unknown op' and fails the gate, blocking the fix experiment even though this experiment (KAN MILP Fix) is listed as INDEPENDENT in the dependency graph.
gate_bug_identified.action_required: Fix gate check configuration for Exp 980: op should be '==' or 'lte' or equivalent. This is a roadmap YAML config bug, not a code bug in the experiment itself.

process_observations: Missing try/finally in experiment scripts causes non-artifact production — same root cause as Exp 971 in .75. A conductor pre-launch check that verifies the script contains artifact-write logic before running would catch this class of failure.
Gate check config bug (op='') blocked an independent experiment (Exp 980) that had no upstream dependency. Roadmap YAML validation at load time would catch unknown ops before the milestone runs.

The .76 roadmap correctly identified the dependency chain (Exp 975 → 976 → 978 → 979 → 981) but did not protect against the case where Exp 975 itself fails silently without writing an artifact. A post-experiment artifact-existence check should fail loudly and halt the milestone rather than proceeding to gate-blocked downstream experiments.
